title: The Password under the Keyboard
story: The office printer rejected Jonah’s password, and he found the old one written on a sticky note under the keyboard. He signed in once, then deleted the note and stored a new password in the password manager. A colleague warned that shared machines were the reason the account had been locked before. Jonah also turned on a logout reminder for the shared machine.

vocabulary.definition: Removed something so that it was gone.
Used by more than one person.
Closed so that the usual person cannot get in.
A message that tells you to do something.

quiz.question: Where did Jonah find the old password?
options: On a sticky note under the keyboard
Inside the password manager from the start
On the screen of the printer
In a warning from his colleague
quiz.correctAnswer: On a sticky note under the keyboard
quiz.explanation: He found the old password written on a sticky note under the keyboard.
quiz.supportingSentence: The office printer rejected Jonah’s password, and he found the old one written on a sticky note under the keyboard.

quiz.question: What risk did the sticky note create?
options: Someone could find and read the password
The printer could store the note more safely
His colleague would be unable to warn him
A reminder cannot work without a keyboard
quiz.correctAnswer: Someone could find and read the password
quiz.explanation: The old password was written on a note under the keyboard, where another person could see it.
quiz.supportingSentence: The office printer rejected Jonah’s password, and he found the old one written on a sticky note under the keyboard.

quiz.question: What is the logout reminder meant to stop?
options: A later user staying inside Jonah’s session
The printer asking for a new keyboard
His colleague buying a private machine
The password manager deleting the account
quiz.correctAnswer: A later user staying inside Jonah’s session
quiz.explanation: A logout reminder on a shared machine is there so the next person does not continue in his session.
quiz.supportingSentence: Jonah also turned on a logout reminder for the shared machine.

quiz.question: What does rejected mean in this story?
options: Refused to accept
Wrote down on paper
Stored in a safe list
Warned a colleague
quiz.explanation: The printer rejected the password, meaning it would not accept it.
quiz.supportingSentence: The office printer rejected Jonah’s password, and he found the old one written on a sticky note under the keyboard.

quiz.question: Why did Jonah store the new password in a manager?
options: So it would be kept without being left in sight
So the printer would remain locked
So the sticky note could be shared
So the account would be locked again
quiz.correctAnswer: So it would be kept without being left in sight
quiz.explanation: He deleted the note and stored the new password in the manager instead of leaving it written down.
quiz.supportingSentence: He signed in once, then deleted the note and stored a new password in the password manager.
